name: Notion
description: A connected workspace for notes, documents, projects and team knowledge.
longDescription: Notion combines documents, databases and collaboration features in a flexible workspace. Features and plan limits vary by plan.
limitations: Advanced capabilities may require paid plans

articleContent.introduction: Notion is a flexible workspace for organizing information and collaborative work.
articleContent.overview: Users combine pages, databases and collaboration features to create workflows.
articleContent.howItWorks: Start with pages and databases, then organize them around a personal or team process.
articleContent.evaluation: Assess permissions, offline needs, export options and plan limits before adopting it for critical workflows.

faqs.q: Can Notion be used for free?
faqs.a: Notion offers a free plan; check its current plan comparison for limits.
